{{Top|leg}}
A '''field energizer''' was a component of the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. It was considered to be an easily obtainable part, along with the [[Stabilizing ring/Legends|stabilizing ring]], [[Flux aperture/Legends|flux aperture]] and [[Power cell/Legends|power cell]].
